applies_to: Organizations in Bahrain & foreign firms using means in Bahrain
key_requirements: Consent or lawful grounds, sensitive data rules, notification to the Authority, cross-border transfer limits
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Authority (functions held by Ministry of Justice, Islamic Affairs and Waqf)
penalties_range: Up to BHD 20k fine; up to 1 year prison
notes: Law No. 30 of 2018; Ministry of Justice exercises Authority functions under a 2019 decree
